scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix backend --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix frontend --audit-level=high
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
